from collections import deque
def flood_enclosed(I):
    H,W=I.shape
    bg=(I!=9)
    # flood from border through bg using 4-conn, but block diagonal passage of walls: use "wall 8-connected" => flood 4-conn on bg should work if walls 8-connect... actually 4-conn flood on bg treats diagonal walls as open. Try both conns.
    res=[]
    for conn in (4,8):
        vis=np.zeros_like(bg)
        dq=deque()
        for r in range(H):
            for c in (0,W-1):
                if bg[r,c] and not vis[r,c]: vis[r,c]=1; dq.append((r,c))
        for c in range(W):
            for r in (0,H-1):
                if bg[r,c] and not vis[r,c]: vis[r,c]=1; dq.append((r,c))
        while dq:
            r,c=dq.popleft()
            nbrs=[(r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)]
            if conn==8: nbrs+= [(r+1,c+1),(r+1,c-1),(r-1,c+1),(r-1,c-1)]
            for nr,nc in nbrs:
                if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and bg[nr,nc] and not vis[nr,nc]:
                    vis[nr,nc]=1; dq.append((nr,nc))
        res.append(vis)
    return res
